meta.name: add-anydoc
meta.description: Add local office-document-to-Markdown conversion to NanoClaw agent containers with the pinned Firecrawl AnyDoc CLI. Use when agents need to read attached Word, PowerPoint, Excel, OpenDocument, RTF, EPUB, CSV, or text-based PDF files without uploading them to a hosted parser.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让你的智能助手直接读懂本地各类办公文档
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你的智能助手需要读取本地办公文档却不便上传到云端
copy.tagline_en: Let your AI agent read local office documents directly
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your AI agent to read local office docs without uploading them.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能在 NanoClaw agent 容器内用固定版本的 Firecrawl AnyDoc CLI,把附加的 Word、PowerPoint、Excel 等本地办公文档转成 Markdown,文件不外传给托管解析器,也不改动原有附件流程。
howto.when: 当 agent 需要读取附加的 Word、PowerPoint、Excel 等办公文档,又不希望把它们上传到托管解析器时,由这个容器技能接管转换。

say.text: 把附加的 report.docx 转成 Markdown,只总结相关段落
say.note: 它按绝对路径读取本地文件

say.text: 把测试用的 PPTX 和 XLSX 转成 Markdown
say.note: 结果写入 agent 的 converted 目录

say.text: 用纯图片的 PDF 试一下,确认它会明确报错且不上传
say.note: 图片型 PDF 需要 OCR

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can convert attached local Word, PowerPoint, Excel, and other office documents to Markdown inside NanoClaw agent containers using the pinned Firecrawl AnyDoc CLI, without uploading files to a hosted parser.
howto.when_en: Triggers when an agent must read attached Word, PowerPoint, Excel, or similar office documents and should not send them to a hosted parser.

say_en.text: Convert the attached report.docx to Markdown and summarize only the relevant parts.
say_en.note: It reads the file from its absolute local path.

say_en.text: Convert the test PPTX and XLSX files to Markdown.
say_en.note: Output lands in the agent's converted directory.

say_en.text: Try an image-only PDF and check that it fails with a clear error.
